name: Aegis local infrastructure HTTP protocol
authentication: No multi-user authentication. Host/origin/custom-header guards restrict browser access; local programs with host access are trusted. Do not expose this service publicly.

errors.400: Malformed path/JSON or unsupported request fields
errors.403: Unrecognized host/origin or missing client marker
errors.409: Service validation, integrity, locking or operation failure

telemetry.guarantee: A retry with the same batch ID and identical payload is ignored while its receipt is retained. No global exactly-once guarantee.
telemetry.defaultPropPolicy: No prop values. Explicit per-component policy required.

AI.sends: Allowlisted aggregate counts, technical component IDs and health findings. No raw events, arbitrary prop values, project display names or user data.

endpoints.purpose: Pinned release, health, aggregate usage, configuration inventory summary and last20 operation records.
Source-derived API dimensions and explicitly evidenced verification records. Cartesian estimates are not coverage.
Persist reviewable rule-based or explicitly requested AI advisory. Does not execute proposals.
Repair only derived drift from unchanged approved source, keep evidence, independently rescan.
Enable local usage or disable and clear retained events and receipts.
Atomically accept at most100 allowlisted events with bounded retry deduplication.
